images.title: Up two then down three
images.purpose: Show that moving +2 and then −3 from the Toy Store ends one floor below the Toy Store.
images.composition: One vertical line with floor dots centred, with two arrows side by side to its right and the equation centred below.
images.exact_structure: One vertical grey #6B7280 line with 4 equally spaced dots marked from top to bottom +2, +1, 0, −1 (4 dots only). The dot 0 is marked Toy Store and is teal #0072B2. The dot −1 is reddish purple #CC79A7. One teal arrow of 2 steps goes up from 0 to +2. Next to it one amber #E69F00 arrow of 3 steps goes down from +2 to −1. Below, centred, the equation line. Exactly 4 dots, 2 arrows, 1 equation.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec

images.takeaway: Going up 2 and then down 3 ends 1 floor below the start.
images.description: A vertical line with dots at +2, +1, 0 (Toy Store) and −1; a teal arrow of 2 steps up, an amber arrow of 3 steps down ending at −1, and (+2) + (−3) = −1 below.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to trace the teal arrow up and the amber arrow down and say where the path ends compared with the Toy Store.

image_decisions.why: Two moves one after the other are easiest to see as arrows; one clean image carries it.
